title: What GitLab says about each connection's token now
description: GET /api/v1/integrations/gitlab/tokens takes no query. For each usable glab login the mapped daemon reads /user (the token must still authenticate the user glab's entry names, account_mismatch otherwise) and /personal_access_tokens/self with that login's own token, so Koodipalvelut can show the scopes, the expiry date and whether push works without any stored copy. One connection failing never hides another; a failure is a fixed code.
